name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 14, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Celia Taghdiri, Member of the Baha’i Faith
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation to the San Diego County Commission on Children, Youth and Families declaring the month of April 2009 to be "Child Abuse Prevention Month" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation declaring April 15, 2009, "Tory Walker P.E. Day" in the City of Vista for the cost savings realized for engineering work on the S. Santa Fe Avenue retention basin.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Second Reading of Ordinance (CC)
C4.
Special Event Banner Program - 2009 Calendar Year (CC)
C5.
Amendment to Employee Computer Purchase Program (CC)
C6.
Traffic Signal Maintenance Service Agreement (CC)
C7.
No Parking Zone on W. Orange Street (CC)
C8.
Partnerships with Industry Services Agreement (CC)
C9.
FY 2009-2010 Sewer Capacity Fee Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , in accordance with City Council Ordinance No. 2006-6; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2006-2.
C10.
Transit Oriented Development Grant Application (CDC)
C11.
Design Agreements for Downtown Mixed Use Project (CDC)
1.
Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with Newman Garrison Gilmour + Partners;
2.
Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with LandArcWest; and
3.
Resolution No. 2009- , approving an agreement with Alliance Land Planning and Engineering, Inc. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Sewer Ordinances (CC/BSD)
1.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Repealing Chapter 13.04 and Amending and Readopting in its Entirety Title 14 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Sewers and Sewer Systems"; and
2.
Introduce Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Buena Sanitation District, California, Amending and Readopting in its Entirety Chapters 1 through 16 of the Buena Sanitation District Sewer Code of Regulations."
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Zoning Code Amendment Regarding Temporary Medical Facilities (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendment to the Development Code, close the public hearing; and (Recommended Action continued on following page)
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 18.58.580 of the Development Code Relating to the Use of Modular Buildings or Commercial Coaches as Temporary Medical Facilities."
PH2.
Zoning Code Amendment Regarding Commercial Uses (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendments to the Development Code and Specific Plans, close the public hearing; and
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 18 of the Development Code, Specific Plan No. 26, and the Townsite Specific Plan Relating to Commercial Uses."
PH3.
21-Unit Condominium Project at 231 Iron Drive (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the Negative Declaration, General Plan Amendment, Specific Plan Amendment, Tentative Subdivision Map, Site Development Plan and Condominium Housing Permit, close the public hearing; and:
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Negative Declaration for the Ironwood Villas Project at 231 Iron Drive;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a General Plan Amendment to change the land use designation on 1.75 acres from Medium Low Density (MLD) to Medium High Density (MHD) at 231 Iron Drive;
4.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Approving a Specific Plan Amendment to Change the Zoning Designation from R-1 (Single-Family Residential) to R-M-15 (Multi-Family Residential) for 1.75 Acres at 231 Iron Drive"; (Recommended Action continued on following page)
5.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Tentative Subdivision Map, Site Development Plan and Condominium Housing Permit for a one-lot subdivision for 21 residential condominium units and associated site improvements at 231 Iron Drive.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
